groups.saying_opens: لا رقية إلا من عين أو حمة

notes: Two sayings (rule 4a): Imran's «لا رقية» and Ibn Abbas's report of the Prophet's vision, which Amir raised with Said ibn Jubayr («فذكرته لسعيد بن جبير فقال حدثنا ابن عباس»).
Saying 2's route runs through Amir because he is the one who mentioned it, and Said answers as a link (rule 5).
